isolation_verdict.rollback: Block-end rollback rewrites the generator: bringup_teardown.py disables both pktgen apps and restores tf1.pktgen.app_cfg READ and OPERATE to their pre-install entries (retained m4 teardown.log lines 1-2, 24-25, 45-46: "left disabled (default was a disabled one-shot)"), and the block restore cold-swaps the production program (m4 restore_verify.json ok).
